limits/max_per_user.label: Max schedules one user owns
limits/max_per_user.description: A user at the limit cannot create one more, in the panel or through an agent's schedule_create. Admin has no limit; an owner change is not limited.

limits/max_per_agent_view.label: Max schedules an agent_view owns
limits/max_per_agent_view.description: The limit for schedules an agent creates with schedule_create when its job has no panel user.

presets.label: Recurrence presets (label to RRULE, for example FREQ=DAILY;BYHOUR=9;BYMINUTE=0)
